description: This Java class 'RequestedAcksValueValidator' is a validator that checks if a given CharSequence is a JSON array of AcknowledgementLabel objects. It throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException if validation fails.

classes.name: RequestedAcksValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for validating if a CharSequence contains a JSON array of acknowledgement labels, ensuring data integrity for header validation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestedAcksValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates whether the provided CharSequence is a JSON array of acknowledgement labels; throws exception if invalid.
